method: Speedup: median and IQR of paired trial ratios. Cost: median/IQR of elapsed_ns / n. Variability: all raw trials at largest N. IQR is observed spread, not a confidence interval. No exclusions.
limitations: Only AXPY in latest saved data. Cache transitions are not independently established. Single-call timing includes harness overhead. Timing alone does not identify the cause of variability.
